class.name: CompositorEffect
class.experimental: The implementation may change as more of the rendering internals are exposed over time.
class.brief_description: This resource allows for creating a custom rendering effect.
class.description: This resource defines a custom rendering effect that can be applied to [Viewport]s through the viewports' [Environment]. You can implement a callback that is called during rendering at a given stage of the rendering pipeline and allows you to insert additional passes. Note that this callback happens on the rendering thread. CompositorEffect is an abstract base class and must be extended to implement specific rendering logic.

method.name: _render_callback
method.description: Implement this function with your custom rendering code. [param effect_callback_type] should always match the effect callback type you've specified in [member effect_callback_type]. [param render_data] provides access to the rendering state, it is only valid during rendering and should not be stored.

method.name: get_layer_texture
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the engine-owned render target that holds the members of [param render_layer] (see [member GeometryInstance3D.render_layer]), so this effect can composite it back into the scene. Pass one of the resources listed in [member render_layers] — the same resource object the member instances reference, never a name or index. This method may only be called from within [method _render_callback]; it reads the current frame's render buffers. It returns an empty [RID] if called at any other time, if [param render_layer] is [code]null[/code], or if no member drew into that layer this frame. The target is resolved by the passed resource's identity. A target exists only for a layer some effect declares in [member render_layers] — the declaration is what makes the engine produce it — and whose members drew this frame; pass the same resource object the members reference. [b]Note:[/b] Only supported by the Forward+ rendering method. Check [method RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method] to feature-detect at runtime.

members.member: The type of effect that is implemented, determines at what stage of rendering the callback is called.
If [code]true[/code] this rendering effect is applied to any viewport it is added to.
If [code]true[/code] this triggers specular data being rendered to a separate buffer and combined after effects have been applied, only applicable for the Forward+ renderer.

The compositor render layers this effect owns. Each [CompositorRenderLayer] listed here declares a held-out target that member instances (see [member GeometryInstance3D.render_layer]) draw into; read the target back inside [method _render_callback] with [method get_layer_texture] to composite it into the scene. This declaration is authoritative: it is resolved and pushed to the [RenderingServer] at registration, and the engine only produces a held-out target for a layer that some effect declares here. A member instance that references a layer no effect declares produces no target. Declaring the same layer more than once is reported and the duplicate ignored. The layer's format, seed source, and stage are read from the [CompositorRenderLayer] resource itself (the single source of truth), so editing them takes effect live. [b]Note:[/b] Only supported by the Forward+ rendering method; on other renderers a declared layer is refused, naming the renderer. Check [method RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method] to feature-detect at runtime.

constants.constant: The callback is called before our opaque rendering pass, but after depth prepass (if applicable).
The callback is called after our opaque rendering pass, but before our sky is rendered.
The callback is called after our sky is rendered, but before our back buffers are created (and if enabled, before subsurface scattering and/or screen space reflections).
The callback is called before our transparent rendering pass, but after our sky is rendered and we've created our back buffers.
The callback is called after our transparent rendering pass, but before any built-in post-processing effects and output to our render target.
Represents the size of the [enum EffectCallbackType] enum.
